say.variants.experienced: Ran into armed crews {scene.location} myself, {addressee.name}. They aren't asking polite questions.
Took shots {scene.location} earlier, {addressee.name}. Raiders are hitting anybody moving gear.
Those highwaymen aren't rumors, {addressee.name}—we barely slipped past a roadblock this morning.
say.variants.witnessed: Saw armed crews working {scene.location} from the treeline, {addressee.name}. Keep your head down.
Watched three trucks full of gunmen roll past the crossroads, {addressee.name}. Stay off the blacktop.
Spotted lookout scouts perched {scene.location}, {addressee.name}. Raiders are out in force.
say.variants.rumor: Heard armed crews are working the highway, {addressee.name}. Best we stick to the back roads.
Word from the river road is bandits have been ambushing supply runs all week, {addressee.name}.
Folks say raider gangs are thick along the main routes right now, {addressee.name}.
say.variants.uncertain: Not sure how organized they are, {addressee.name}, but I keep hearing talk of roadblocks past town.
Could be just scared travelers talking, {addressee.name}, though nobody's taking the interstate lately.
Hard to confirm, {addressee.name}, but word is somebody's been shaking down scavengers near the bridge.
say.variants.reply: Copy that, {addressee.name}. Keep a shell chambered and stay off the open pavement.
Good looking out, {addressee.name}. We'll stick to the woods and watch the flanks.
I hear you, {addressee.name}. No sense walking into an ambush for a few cans of beans.
